title: IntakeBundle
description: Output of the Intake worker: validated and enriched product identity.

display_name.description: Human-readable product name (e.g. Aspose.Cells for Python).

canonical_import.description: Canonical import statement for the product (e.g. import aspose.cells).

runtime_import.description: Runtime module import path (e.g. aspose.threed). May differ from canonical_import.

repo_sha.description: Git SHA of the repository HEAD, pinned at intake time.

repo_dir.description: Filesystem path to the cached clone directory.
